coach.opener: Solid shift, PhogsToffees. A 7.7 clears the bar for a forward, and solid is the soil good things grow in.
coach.closer: I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you.

push.title: L 1-3 vs Bubba Bros Fc | You: 7.7 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
Your 3rd best match performance, PhogsToffees: a 7.7. Good day at the office.

DID WELL
+ 4 shots at Bubba Bros Fc's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ A goal against Bubba Bros Fc. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ Your 3rd best match performance at 7.7. Do it again.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. Solid foundation stuff.
+ 3 goals conceded: +0.1. The details are doing their job.

WORK ON
- 67% passing (28 of 42, down from your usual 76%). Think about this: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder. That's how good becomes great.
- Shots on target: 75%. Solid, but the best forwards hit 90%+.
- Goals per shot on target: 33%. Raise it to 60%+ and you're a difference maker.
- Key passes: 1. Climb to 2+ and you're top quarter.
- Fell 1-3 to Bubba Bros Fc. Tomorrow's a better story.

Try this in practice: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

You're closer than you think. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.2, below average for the position) - best at chance creation; work on tackle timing.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: BellyTb1, a 7.2 is a touch under par for a midfielder. That's alright. Even the best tomatoes have a bruise or two.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.

push.title: L 1-3 vs Bubba Bros Fc | You: 7.2 (worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.2 against Bubba Bros Fc. Hard nights build hard players. Soft hearts, hard players.

DID WELL
+ 1 assist. That pass had more vision than a lighthouse.
+ Every time you found PhogsToffees, something good happened.
+ 16 completed passes was worth +0.2. Nice bonus.

WORK ON
- Won 0 of 3 tackles (down from your usual 44%). Here's the deal: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind. Feet first, then flair.
- 1.0 down on your average. Even the best hitters have 0-for-4 nights.
- Your worst match performance (7.2). We'll get you back up the list.
- 6 misplaced passes: -0.2. Practice makes permanent.
- Pass accuracy: 73%. Don't settle; 87%+ is there for the taking.

Five minutes of this: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Better days are booked. - Coach Lasso

work_on.tip: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
